_comments: In-app notice that an item was shared. Email and SMS stay off. There is no template.

fields.Name: Collaboration Share
fields.Description: An item was shared with a member of a space.

_comments: Sent once per member when a space enters a status whose NotifyMembersOnEnter is on (Paused, Closed by default): 'X paused Northwind relationship'. In-app by default; email off until a template exists. A person's act, so its origin is Person and MJ: Scoped Notification Configs may still quiet it per application or role.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Space Status Changed
fields.Description: A space a member belongs to changed status.

_comments: Sent when a person is invited to a space via an external identity provider without a magic link. In-app by default; email sent through the host communication provider when configured.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Space Invite
fields.Description: A person was invited to a space and can sign in using their organization account.

_comments: NT-1 notification when a member is @mentioned in a space conversation, note, or item.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Mention
fields.Description: A member was mentioned in a space conversation, note, or task.

_comments: NT-1 notification when a reply is posted to a thread or comment in a space.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Reply
fields.Description: A new reply was posted to a conversation thread or comment in a space.

_comments: NT-1 notification when a space task is assigned, updated, or completed.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Task
fields.Description: A task in a space was assigned or updated.

_comments: NT-1 notification when a space approval request or decision requires attention or completes.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Approval
fields.Description: An approval request or decision occurred in a space.

_comments: NT-2 scheduled scoped digest summarizing reach-verified space activity for a member.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Digest
fields.Description: Scheduled scoped digest of reach-verified notices and updates across spaces.
